title: Dongson founders cast a miniature bronze drum
summary: A miniature Dongson bronze drum from Vietnam carries four frogs, preserving a small-scale form of a widely distributed drum tradition.

citations.locator: Object 2000.284.57; ca. 500 BCE–300 CE, Vietnam, and uncertain drum functions
citations.note: Supports the linked claims within the stated date and attribution limits.

claims.text: A miniature Dongson bronze drum from Vietnam carries four frogs, preserving a small-scale form of a widely distributed drum tradition.
The catalogue’s broad 500 BCE–300 CE range estimates one casting. Astronomical year −499 represents 500 BCE; this is not an 800-year duration.
Bronze drums occur in burial contexts across Southeast Asia. Suggested ritual and political functions remain uncertain; this object cannot establish one universal use.

review.corroboration: The Met catalogue date and function discussion were inspected. A regional museum guide was located in discovery but not used as corroborating evidence.
